# Assessment task: Stage 1 (Quadrant A) - Web server in the default VPC

Write an AWS CloudFormation template in YAML that deploys a Linux web server on a single Amazon EC2 instance in the account's default VPC and default subnet. The template will be deployed in a fresh account in any commercial AWS Region.

Requirements:
R1. Declare a parameter for the name of an existing EC2 key pair (type AWS::EC2::KeyPair::KeyName) and a parameter for the administrator's IPv4 CIDR block that is allowed to connect over SSH.
R2. Resolve the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI at deploy time from the public AWS Systems Manager parameter /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64. Do not hard-code an AMI ID.
R3. Use instance type t3.micro (a parameter that defaults to t3.micro is acceptable).
R4. Create a security group that allows inbound HTTPS (TCP 443) from anywhere (0.0.0.0/0).
R5. The same security group allows inbound SSH (TCP 22) only from the administrator CIDR parameter.
R6. Allow no other inbound traffic: the security group must contain only the two inbound rules above.
R7. Use EC2 user data to install the Apache HTTP Server (httpd) and mod_ssl, write an index.html page, and start httpd and enable it at boot.
R8. Use the default VPC: the template must not create a VPC, subnet, internet gateway or route table.
R9. Output the instance's public DNS name and an https:// URL for the website.

Output format: return the complete template in a single fenced code block marked yaml, and nothing else.
briefs.T2:
# Assessment task: Stage 2 (Quadrant B) - Custom VPC, database tier and launch template

Write an AWS CloudFormation template in YAML for the second stage of a photo-sharing website. The template will be deployed in a fresh account in any commercial AWS Region, possibly more than once in the same account and Region.

Requirements:
R1. Create a VPC with CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 with DNS support and DNS hostnames enabled.
R2. Create two public subnets and two private subnets. The two public subnets must be in two different Availability Zones, and so must the two private subnets. Select Availability Zones with Fn::GetAZs (do not hard-code Availability Zone names). Public subnets must assign public IPv4 addresses on launch.
R3. Create and attach an internet gateway. Create a public route table with a default route (0.0.0.0/0) to the internet gateway and associate it with both public subnets.
R4. Create a private route table that has no route to the internet gateway and associate it with both private subnets.
R5. Define the web server configuration in an AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate (do not use a launch configuration). The launch template takes the custom AMI ID from a parameter of type AWS::EC2::Image::Id, uses instance type t3.micro, attaches the web security group, and includes user data that installs and starts httpd and PHP.
R6. Launch one web server EC2 instance from that launch template into a public subnet, and associate an Elastic IP address with it (static public IP).
R7. The web security group allows inbound TCP 80 and TCP 443 from anywhere and inbound TCP 22 only from an administrator CIDR parameter.
R8. Create an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance (db.t3.micro) in a DB subnet group made of the two private subnets. It must not be publicly accessible and its storage must be encrypted.
R9. Do not place the database master password in plain text in the template: use ManageMasterUserPassword, a Secrets Manager dynamic reference, or a NoEcho parameter.
R10. The database security group allows inbound TCP 3306 only from the web security group (by security group reference) and has no other inbound rules.
R11. Output the website URL (using the Elastic IP) and the database endpoint address.

Output format: return the complete template in a single fenced code block marked yaml, and nothing else.
briefs.T3:
# Assessment task: Stage 3 (Quadrant C) - Secure, scalable, highly available deployment

Write an AWS CloudFormation template in YAML for the third stage of a photo-sharing website. The web tier must not be publicly reachable except through the load balancer. The template will be deployed in a fresh account in any commercial AWS Region, possibly more than once in the same account and Region.

Requirements:
R1. Create a VPC (10.0.0.0/16) with two public and two private subnets; the public subnets are in two different Availability Zones and so are the private subnets. Select Availability Zones with Fn::GetAZs; do not hard-code Availability Zone names.
R2. Create and attach an internet gateway, with a public route table whose default route (0.0.0.0/0) targets the internet gateway, associated with both public subnets.
R3. Create a NAT gateway with an Elastic IP in a public subnet. The private subnets use route table(s) whose default route targets the NAT gateway, and they have no route to the internet gateway.
R4. Create an internet-facing Application Load Balancer in the two public subnets, with an HTTP listener on port 80 that forwards to a target group. The target group health check uses HTTP on path /health.
R5. The load balancer security group allows inbound TCP 80 from anywhere.
R6. The web instance security group allows inbound TCP 80 only from the load balancer security group (by security group reference) and allows no inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0.
R7. Define instances with an AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate (not a launch configuration) that takes the custom AMI ID from a parameter of type AWS::EC2::Image::Id, uses t3.micro, attaches the web security group and an IAM instance profile, and does not assign public IP addresses.
R8. Create an Auto Scaling group across the two private subnets using the launch template, with minimum 2, maximum 4 and desired capacity 2, registered with the target group and using ELB health checks.
R9. Scale on load: add a target-tracking scaling policy on average CPU utilisation with a target of at most 70 percent (a step or simple scaling policy driven by a CloudWatch CPU alarm is also acceptable).
R10. Create an S3 bucket for uploaded photos with all four S3 Block Public Access settings enabled.
R11. Create an IAM role that EC2 can assume and an instance profile for it. The role's permissions for S3 must be limited to s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject and s3:DeleteObject on objects in the photo bucket only (no wildcard actions such as s3:*, and no Resource "*" for S3 actions).
R12. Create an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance (db.t3.micro) with Multi-AZ enabled, in a DB subnet group made of the two private subnets, not publicly accessible, with encrypted storage, and with no plain-text master password (use ManageMasterUserPassword, a Secrets Manager dynamic reference, or a NoEcho parameter).
R13. The database security group allows inbound TCP 3306 only from the web instance security group.
R14. Create a CloudFront distribution whose origin is the load balancer's DNS name (custom origin, origin protocol http-only) and whose default cache behaviour redirects viewers from HTTP to HTTPS.
R15. The template must be redeployable: no hard-coded AMI IDs, no hard-coded Availability Zone names, and no fixed physical names (for example a literal BucketName) that would collide on a second deployment in the same account.
R16. Output the CloudFront domain name and the load balancer DNS name.

Output format: return the complete template in a single fenced code block marked yaml, and nothing else.

# Assessment task: Application tier (Stages 2 and 3) - Photo upload and search with the AWS SDK

The course allows any programming language. Write a Python 3.11 module named photoapp.py that implements the application logic of the photo-sharing website. Use only the Python standard library; the S3 client object is passed in by the caller (in production it is a boto3 S3 client created from the EC2 instance role), and the database connection is any DB-API 2.0 connection whose parameter style is qmark ("?"), such as sqlite3.

Implement exactly these functions:

init_db(conn) -> None
    Create the table photos if it does not exist, with columns id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT), title (TEXT NOT NULL), description (TEXT), s3_key (TEXT NOT NULL) and uploaded_at (TEXT NOT NULL, an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp). Commit.

save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, s3_key) -> int
    Insert one row and return its id. Titles and descriptions may contain any characters, including quotes, semicolons and SQL keywords, and must be stored exactly as given. Commit.

search_photos(conn, term) -> list[dict]
    Return rows whose title or description contains term, case-insensitively, ordered by id ascending, as dicts with keys id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at. The term is untrusted user input.

upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type) -> str
    Validate and upload one photo and return its S3 object key. Accept only content types image/jpeg and image/png, and only data of at most 5 MiB (5 * 1024 * 1024 bytes); otherwise raise ValueError. The key must be "photos/<32 lowercase hex characters from uuid4>/<safe name>", where <safe name> is the base name of filename with any directory components removed and every character outside A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-' replaced by '_'. Upload with s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type).

photo_url(s3, bucket, key, expires=3600) -> str
    Return a presigned GET URL for the object by calling s3.generate_presigned_url("get_object", Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key}, ExpiresIn=expires). Raise ValueError if expires is not between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive.

handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int
    Upload the photo, then save its metadata, and return the new row id. If saving the metadata raises an exception, delete the uploaded object with s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key) and re-raise the original exception.

Never embed AWS credentials or create AWS clients in the module.

Output format: return the complete module in a single fenced code block marked python, and nothing else.

common: No tools, internet access or AWS account are available to you in this conversation. Respond with the deliverable only, in exactly the output format specified at the end of the brief.

mcq.stem: Which of the following is one of the five essential characteristics of cloud computing in the NIST definition?

options.C: Fixed-capacity provisioning

mcq.stem: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which task is the customer's responsibility when using Amazon EC2?

options.C: Physical security of data centres
options.D: Replacing failed disks in the host

mcq.stem: What is an AWS Availability Zone?

options.A: A geographic area containing multiple Regions
options.B: One or more discrete data centres with redundant power and networking within a Region
options.C: An edge location used by CloudFront
options.D: A logical grouping of AWS accounts

mcq.stem: A subnet is called a public subnet in Amazon VPC when:

options.A: Its route table has a route to an internet gateway
options.B: Its CIDR block uses public IP address ranges
options.C: It has a network ACL allowing all traffic
options.D: It contains a NAT gateway's private IP only

mcq.stem: Instances in a private subnet need to download software updates from the internet but must not accept inbound connections initiated from the internet. What should be added?

options.B: A NAT gateway in a public subnet and a default route to it from the private route table
options.C: An internet gateway route in the private route table
options.D: An Elastic IP on each private instance

mcq.stem: Which statement about security groups and network ACLs is correct?

options.A: Security groups are stateless and network ACLs are stateful
options.B: Security groups are stateful and network ACLs are stateless
options.C: Both are stateless

mcq.stem: A security group has one inbound rule allowing TCP 80 from 0.0.0.0/0 and the default outbound rule. Which is true?

options.A: All inbound traffic is allowed because there is no deny rule
options.B: Responses to allowed inbound HTTP requests are blocked unless an outbound rule allows them
options.C: Inbound SSH is allowed by default
options.D: Responses to allowed inbound HTTP requests are automatically allowed

mcq.stem: A student checks whether a web server is serving pages by running ping against it and gets no reply. Which conclusion is justified?

options.A: HTTP is blocked by the security group
options.C: The web server is down
options.D: Nothing definite about HTTP: ping uses ICMP, which may be blocked while TCP 80/443 is allowed

mcq.stem: An IAM identity-based policy allows s3:GetObject on a bucket and another attached policy explicitly denies s3:GetObject on the same bucket. What is the result?

options.A: Access is denied because an explicit deny overrides any allow
options.B: The most recently attached policy wins
options.C: Access is allowed because an allow exists
options.D: Access depends on the order of statements

mcq.stem: What is the recommended way for an application on EC2 to obtain credentials to call Amazon S3?

options.A: Attach an IAM role to the instance through an instance profile
options.B: Store an IAM user's access keys in the application configuration file
options.C: Embed the root account keys in user data
options.D: Use the S3 bucket owner's console password

mcq.stem: Which principle states that an identity should be granted only the permissions required to perform its task?

options.C: Separation of duties

mcq.stem: Which load balancer type operates at layer 7 and can route requests based on URL path?

options.C: Application Load Balancer
options.D: Classic Load Balancer operating in TCP mode

mcq.stem: An Auto Scaling group uses ELB health checks. What happens when an instance fails the load balancer's target group health check?

options.A: Nothing; only EC2 status checks are used
options.B: The Auto Scaling group marks it unhealthy and replaces it
options.C: The load balancer terminates the instance directly

mcq.stem: Which scaling policy type keeps a metric such as average CPU utilisation close to a specified value?

options.C: Manual scaling

mcq.stem: AWS recommends which resource for defining the instance configuration used by new Auto Scaling groups?

options.C: Launch configuration

mcq.stem: What is the primary purpose of Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployment (with one standby)?

options.A: To provide high availability with automatic failover to a standby in another Availability Zone
options.C: To replicate data to another Region for analytics
options.D: To scale read traffic across replicas

mcq.stem: Which option is designed mainly to offload read traffic from a primary RDS database?

options.C: Read replica

mcq.stem: Which feature lets you restore an RDS DB instance to any second within the backup retention period (typically up to the last five minutes)?

options.C: Point-in-time recovery using automated backups

mcq.stem: What is the main benefit of placing Amazon CloudFront in front of a web application?

options.A: It replaces the need for a database
options.B: It caches content at edge locations, reducing latency and origin load
options.C: It encrypts data at rest in S3

mcq.stem: A private S3 bucket stores photos. The web page must let a browser download one photo for a limited time without making the bucket public. What should the application generate?

options.B: An IAM user for each visitor
options.C: A presigned URL for the object
options.D: A public ACL on the object

mcq.stem: Which S3 feature prevents any bucket policy or ACL from granting public access?

options.C: S3 Versioning

mcq.stem: In AWS CloudFormation, what does the intrinsic function Fn::GetAtt return?

options.A: The list of Availability Zones in the Region
options.C: The value of a template parameter
options.D: The value of an attribute of a resource in the template

mcq.stem: Which CloudFormation feature lets you preview how proposed changes will affect running resources before you apply them?

options.C: Nested stack

mcq.stem: Why can hard-coding an AMI ID in a CloudFormation template make it fail in another Region?

options.A: CloudFormation does not accept AMI IDs
options.B: AMI IDs are account-specific for public images in every case
options.C: AMI IDs are Region-specific

mcq.stem: A web application writes user input into SQL queries by string concatenation. Which practice most directly prevents SQL injection?

options.C: Placing the database in a private subnet

mcq.stem: How many pillars does the AWS Well-Architected Framework currently define?

options.C: Six

mcq.stem: Which pairing of Well-Architected pillar and concern is correct?

options.C: Sustainability - minimising environmental impact of workloads

mcq.stem: Which EC2 purchasing option is generally the cheapest for fault-tolerant, interruptible batch workloads?

options.A: Reserved capacity in a single AZ with no commitment
options.C: Spot Instances

mcq.stem: An instance in a private subnet with a correct NAT route still cannot reach the internet, and the NAT is a self-managed NAT instance. Which setting on the NAT instance is a common cause?

options.A: Source/destination checking has not been disabled
options.C: The instance has an IAM role

mcq.stem: Which design best removes a single point of failure for a stateless web tier?

options.B: Two instances in the same subnet
options.C: One large instance with an Elastic IP
options.D: Instances in an Auto Scaling group spread across multiple Availability Zones behind a load balancer
